questions.question: How are target resolution times used in the 'incident management' practice?

options.A: They are agreed, documented, and communicated to help set user expectations
options.B: They are established, reviewed, and reported to ensure that customers are happy with the service
options.C: They are initiated, approved, and managed to ensure that predictable responses are achieved
options.D: They are scheduled, assessed and authorized to reduce the risk of service failures

questions.explanation: Correct answer: A — "They are agreed, documented, and communicated to help set user expectations". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.131 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Why should some service requests be fulfilled with no additional approvals?

options.A: To ensure that spending is properly accounted for
options.B: To ensure that information security requirements are met
options.D: To set user expectations for fulfilment times

questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "To streamline the fulfilment workflow". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.166 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: What is a set of specialized organizational capabilities for enabling value for customers in the form of services?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "Service management". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.205 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which gives a user access to a system?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: D — "Service provision". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.205 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which statement about managing incidents is CORRECT?

options.A: Low impact incidents should be resolved efficiently, making logging unnecessary
options.B: The 'incident management' practice should use a single process regardless of the impact of the incident
options.C: Low impact incidents should be resolved efficiently so the resource required is reduced
options.D: Incidents with the lowest impact should be resolved first

questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "Low impact incidents should be resolved efficiently so the resource required is reduced". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.131 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which statement about the service value chain is CORRECT?

options.A: The service value chain converts value into demand
options.B: Each value chain activity uses different combinations of practices to convert inputs into outputs
options.C: Each value chain activity identifies a requirement for resources from an external supplier
options.D: The service value chain uses value streams to describe a combination of consumers and providers

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Each value chain activity uses different combinations of practices to convert inputs into outputs". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.68 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: What describes how components and activities work together to facilitate value creation?

options.C: The four dimensions of service management

questions.explanation: Correct answer: A — "The ITIL service value system". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.47 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: Which practice involves the management of vulnerabilities that were not identified before the service went live?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Problem management". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.143 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which statement about the use of measurement in the 'start where you are' guiding principle is CORRECT?

options.A: It should always be used to support direct observation
options.B: It should always be used instead of direct observation
options.C: Measured data is always more accurate than direct observation
options.D: The act of measuring always positively impacts results

questions.explanation: Correct answer: A — "It should always be used to support direct observation". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.56 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: Which ITIL practice recommends performing service reviews to ensure that services continue to meet the needs of the organization?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "Service level management". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.162 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: What should be considered as part of the 'partners and suppliers' dimension?

options.A: The level of integration and formality involved in the relationships between organizations
options.B: The activities, workflows, controls and procedures needed to achieve the agreed objectives
options.C: The information created, managed and used in the course of service provision and consumption
options.D: The required skills and competencies of teams and individual members of the organization

questions.explanation: Correct answer: A — "The level of integration and formality involved in the relationships between organizations". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.40 (Chapter 3 – The four dimensions of service management).

textbook_references.chapter: Chapter 3 – The four dimensions of service management

questions.question: Which practice makes new services available for use?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Release management". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.203 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which activity contributes to the 'where are we now?' step of the 'continual improvement' model?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Performing baseline assessments". This is supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.77 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: Which guiding principle considers the importance of customer loyalty?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Focus on value". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.49 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: Which is a recommendation of the guiding principle 'think and work holistically'?

options.A: Conduct a review of existing service management practices and decide what to keep and what to discard
options.B: Review how an improvement initiative can be organized into smaller, manageable sections that can be completed in a timely manner
options.C: Review service management practices and remove any unnecessary complexity
options.D: Use the four dimensions of service management to ensure coordination of all aspects of an improvement initiative

questions.explanation: Correct answer: D — "Use the four dimensions of service management to ensure coordination of all aspects of an improvement initiative". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.43 (Chapter 3 – The four dimensions of service management).

textbook_references.chapter: Chapter 3 – The four dimensions of service management

questions.question: Which statement about 'continual improvement' is CORRECT?

options.A: All improvement ideas should be logged in a single 'continual improvement register'
options.B: A single team should carry out 'continual improvement' across the organization
options.C: 'Continual improvement' should have minimal interaction with other practices
options.D: Everyone in the organization is responsible for some aspects of 'continual improvement'

questions.explanation: Correct answer: D — "Everyone in the organization is responsible for some aspects of 'continual improvement'". This is supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.117 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: What impact does automation have on a service desk?

options.A: Less low level work and a greater ability to focus on user experience
options.B: Increased phone contact and a reduced ability to focus on user experience
options.C: Ability to work from multiple locations, geographically dispersed
options.D: Ability to work from a single centralized location

questions.explanation: Correct answer: A — "Less low level work and a greater ability to focus on user experience". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.160 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Identify the missing word(s) in the following sentence: The service desk should be the entry point and single point of contact for the [?] with all of its users.
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Service provider". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.159 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: What aspect of 'service level management' asks service consumers what their work involves and how technology helps them?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: A — "Customer engagement". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.164 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which is a result of applying the guiding principle 'progress iteratively with feedback'?

options.A: The ability to discover and respond to failure earlier
options.C: Understanding the customer's perception of value
options.D: Understanding the current state and identifying what can be reused

questions.explanation: Correct answer: A — "The ability to discover and respond to failure earlier". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.58 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: What can be used to determine if a service is 'fit for purpose'?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: D — "Utility". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.207 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: In service relationships, what is a benefit of identifying consumer roles?

options.C: It removes constraints from the customer
options.D: It enables a common definition of value

questions.explanation: Correct answer: A — "It enables effective stakeholder management". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.21 (Chapter 2 – Key concepts of service management).

textbook_references.chapter: Chapter 2 – Key concepts of service management

questions.question: Which is an external input to the service value chain?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "Customer requirements". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.55 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: What term is used to describe whether a service will meet availability, capacity and security requirements?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: D — "Warranty". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.208 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: What is the purpose of the 'incident management' practice?

options.A: To minimize the negative impact of incidents by restoring normal service operation as quickly as possible
options.B: To capture demand for incident resolution and service requests
options.C: To reduce the likelihood and impact of incidents by identifying actual and potential causes of incidents
options.D: To support the agreed service quality by effective handling of all agreed user-initiated service requests

questions.explanation: Correct answer: A — "To minimize the negative impact of incidents by restoring normal service operation as quickly as possible". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.131 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: What is defined as an unplanned interruption or reduction in the quality of a service?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: A — "An incident". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.131 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which ITIL practice has the purpose to establish and nurture the links between the organization and its stakeholders at strategic and tactical levels?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "Relationship management". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.106 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: What can help to reduce resistance to a planned improvement when applying the guiding principle 'collaborate and promote visibility'?

options.A: Restricting information about the improvement to essential stakeholders only
options.B: Increasing collaboration and visibility for the improvement
options.C: Involving customers after all planning has been completed
options.D: Engaging every stakeholder group in the same way, with the same communication

questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "Involving customers after all planning has been completed". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.59 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: What varies in size and complexity, and uses functions to achieve its objectives?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "An organization". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.19 (Chapter 2 – Key concepts of service management).

textbook_references.chapter: Chapter 2 – Key concepts of service management

questions.question: Which practice ensures that any addition, modification, or removal of anything that could have an effect on services is assessed and authorized?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "Change control". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.129 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which practice has a purpose that includes managing risks to confidentiality, integrity and availability?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: A — "Information security management". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.197 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which will help solve incidents more quickly?

options.B: Escalating all incidents to support teams
options.D: Detailed procedural steps for incident investigation

questions.explanation: Correct answer: D — "Detailed procedural steps for incident investigation". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.133 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: When is the earliest that a workaround can be documented in 'problem management'?

options.A: After the problem has been logged
options.B: After the problem has been prioritized
options.C: After the problem has been analyzed
options.D: After the problem has been resolved

questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "After the problem has been analyzed". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.140 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which is an activity of the 'problem management' practice?

options.A: Restoration of normal service operation as quickly as possible
options.B: Prioritization of problems based on the risk that they pose
options.C: Authorization of changes to resolve the cause of problems
options.D: Resolution of incidents in a time that meets customer expectations

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Prioritization of problems based on the risk that they pose". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.141 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which practice is MOST likely to benefit from the use of chatbots?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: D — "Service desk". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.160 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Where are the details of the required performance outcomes of a service defined?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: A — "Service level agreements". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.162 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which value chain activity ensures a shared understanding of the current status and required direction for all products and services?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: A — "Plan". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.201 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which practice has the purpose of ensuring that the organization's suppliers and their performance are managed appropriately to support the provision of seamless, quality products and services?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Supplier management". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.207 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which two practices interact the MOST with the service desk practice?

options.A: Incident management and service request management
options.B: Service request management and deployment management

questions.explanation: Correct answer: A — "Incident management and service request management". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.39 (Chapter 3 – The four dimensions of service management).

textbook_references.chapter: Chapter 3 – The four dimensions of service management

questions.question: Which is an activity of the 'incident management' practice?

options.D: Automating service requests to the greatest degree possible

questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "Providing good-quality updates when expected". This is supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.132 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Identify the missing words in the following sentence: A user is [?] that uses services.
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "a role". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.205 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which is included in the purpose of the 'change enablement' practice?

options.A: Make new and changed services available for use
options.B: Ensure that risks have been properly assessed
options.C: Record and report selected changes of state
options.D: Plan and manage the full lifecycle of all IT assets

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Ensure that risks have been properly assessed". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.128 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which activity is part of the 'continual improvement' practice?

options.A: Identifying the cause of incidents and recommending related improvements
options.C: Logging and managing incidents that result in improvement opportunities
options.D: Making business cases for improvement action

questions.explanation: Correct answer: D — "Making business cases for improvement action". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.91 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: In which step of the 'continual improvement model' is an improvement plan implemented?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "Take action". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.81 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: Which is the BEST example of a standard change?

options.A: The review and authorization of a change requested by a customer
options.B: The implementation of a critical software patch in response to a vendor security issue
options.C: The installation of a software application in response to a service request
options.D: The replacement of a component in response to a major incident

questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "The installation of a software application in response to a service request". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.146 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which statement about the automation of service requests is CORRECT?

options.A: Service requests that cannot be automated should be handled as incidents
options.B: Service requests and their fulfilment should be automated as much as possible
options.C: Service requests that cannot be automated should be handled as problems
options.D: Service requests and their fulfilment should be carried out by service desk staff without automation

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Service requests and their fulfilment should be automated as much as possible". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.166 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which can act as an operating model for an organization?

options.A: The four dimensions of service management

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "The service value chain". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.67 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: Which practice recommends the use of event-based surveys to gather feedback from customers?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: A — "Service level management". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.165 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which statement about change authorities is CORRECT?

options.A: Change authorities are only required for authorizing emergency changes
options.B: Change authorities are assigned when each change is deployed
options.C: Change authorities are only required for authorizing normal changes
options.D: Change authorities are assigned for each type of change and change model

questions.explanation: Correct answer: D — "Change authorities are assigned for each type of change and change model". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.193 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which practice improves customer and user satisfaction by reducing the negative impact of service interruptions?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "Incident management". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.197 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which will NOT be handled as a service request?

options.B: The replacement of a toner cartridge
options.D: A complaint about a support team

questions.explanation: Correct answer: A — "The degradation of a service". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.166 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: A service offering may include goods, access to resources, and service actions. Which is an example of a service action?

options.A: A mobile phone enables a user to work remotely
options.B: A password allows a user connect to a WiFi network
options.C: A license allows a user to install a software product
options.D: A service desk agent provides support to a user

questions.explanation: Correct answer: D — "A service desk agent provides support to a user". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.205 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which describes a CORRECT approach to change authorization?

options.A: Changes included in the change schedule are pre-authorized and do not need additional authorization
options.B: Normal changes should be assessed and authorized before they are deployed
options.C: Emergency changes should be authorized by as many people as possible to reduce risk
options.D: Normal changes are typically implemented as service requests and authorized by the service desk

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Normal changes should be assessed and authorized before they are deployed". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.129 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which statement about a service value stream is CORRECT?

options.A: It uses prescriptive inputs and outputs
options.B: It is a value chain activity
options.C: It integrates practices for a specific scenario
options.D: It is used to provide governance

questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "It integrates practices for a specific scenario". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.69 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: Which statement about outputs is CORRECT?

options.B: They capture customer demand for services
options.C: They contribute to the achievement of outcomes
options.D: They describe how the service performs

questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "They contribute to the achievement of outcomes". This is supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.40 (Chapter 3 – The four dimensions of service management).

textbook_references.chapter: Chapter 3 – The four dimensions of service management

questions.question: Which is an example of a business related measurement?

options.A: The number of passengers checked in
options.B: The average time to respond to change requests
options.C: The average resolution time for incidents

questions.explanation: Correct answer: A — "The number of passengers checked in". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.21 (Chapter 2 – Key concepts of service management).

textbook_references.chapter: Chapter 2 – Key concepts of service management

questions.question: Which BEST describes the purpose of the 'improve' value chain activity?

options.A: To organize a major improvement initiative into several smaller initiatives
options.B: To make new and improved services and features available for use
options.C: To ensure a shared understanding of the vision and improvement direction for all products and services
options.D: To continually improve all products and services across all value chain activities

questions.explanation: Correct answer: D — "To continually improve all products and services across all value chain activities". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.72 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: Which includes governance, management practices, and continual improvement?

options.B: The 'deliver and support' value chain activity

questions.explanation: Correct answer: A — "The service value system". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.195 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: What is the definition of a problem?

options.A: An unplanned interruption to a service, or reduction in the quality of a service
options.B: A cause, or potential cause, of one or more incidents
options.C: An incident for which a full resolution is not yet available
options.D: Any change of state that has significance for the management of a configuration item (CI)

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "A cause, or potential cause, of one or more incidents". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.201 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which practice provides a communications point for users to report operational issues, queries and requests?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "Service desk". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.159 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which dimension is MOST concerned with skills, competencies, roles and responsibilities?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: A — "Organizations and people". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.200 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: An organization asks a stakeholder to review a planned change. Which guiding principle does this demonstrate?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: A — "Collaborate and promote visibility". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.59 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: Which practice has a strong influence on the user experience and perception of the service provider?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: A — "Service desk". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.160 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which statement about service requests is CORRECT?

options.A: Complex service requests should be dealt with as normal changes
options.B: Service requests that require simple workflows should be dealt with as incidents
options.C: Service requests require workflows that should use manual procedures and avoid automation
options.D: Service requests are usually formalized using standard procedures for initiation, approval and fulfilment

questions.explanation: Correct answer: D — "Service requests are usually formalized using standard procedures for initiation, approval and fulfilment". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.166 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which practice is responsible for moving new or changed components to live or other environments?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Deployment management". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.195 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which dimension focuses on relationships with other organizations that are involved in the design, development, deployment and delivery of services?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "Partners and suppliers". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.40 (Chapter 3 – The four dimensions of service management).

textbook_references.chapter: Chapter 3 – The four dimensions of service management

questions.question: Which of these activities is carried out as part of 'problem management'?

options.C: Escalating incidents to a support team for resolution

questions.explanation: Correct answer: D — "Trend analysis of incident records". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.141 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: What must always be done before an activity is automated?

options.A: Check that the activity has already been optimized
options.B: Check that suitable new technology has been purchased
options.C: Ensure that DevOps has been successfully implemented
options.D: Ensure the solution removes the need for human intervention

questions.explanation: Correct answer: A — "Check that the activity has already been optimized". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.52 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: What is a change schedule PRIMARILY used for?

options.C: To help assign a change authority

questions.explanation: Correct answer: D — "To help manage normal changes". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.129 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which role approves the cost of services?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "Sponsor". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.206 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: What actions does a service desk take for all issues, queries and requests that are reported to them?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: D — "Acknowledge, classify, own". This is supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.159 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which describes the utility of a service?

options.A: A service that is fit for use
options.B: A service that meets its service level targets
options.C: A service that increases constraints on the consumer
options.D: A service that supports the performance of the consumer

questions.explanation: Correct answer: D — "A service that supports the performance of the consumer". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.207 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which is included in the purpose of the 'service level management' practice?

options.A: To maximize the number of successful service and product changes
options.B: To ensure accurate information about the configuration of services is available
options.C: To set clear business-based targets for service levels
options.D: To ensure that suppliers and their performance are managed appropriately

questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "To set clear business-based targets for service levels". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.162 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which usually requires a team of representatives from many stakeholder groups?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: D — "Investigating a major incident". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.132 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which value chain activity ensures that service components meet agreed specifications?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "Obtain/build". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.200 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: What includes governance as a component?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "The service value system". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.195 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which practice needs people who understand complex systems and have creative and analytical skills?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: D — "Problem management". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.142 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: What is the definition of a known error?

options.A: An unplanned interruption to a service, or reduction in the quality of a service
options.B: A cause, or potential cause, of one or more incident
options.C: A problem that has been analyzed and has not been resolved
options.D: Any change of state that has significance for the management of a service or other configuration item (CI)

questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "A problem that has been analyzed and has not been resolved". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.140 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which guiding principle is PRIMARILY concerned with end-to-end service delivery?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Think and work holistically". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.62 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: What are typically recognized through notifications created by an IT service, CI or monitoring tool?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "Events". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.138 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).
